mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across economic cycles without requiring specific conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face downward pressure.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer and housing demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 210), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement tighter monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates expanding economic activity and corporate hiring, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves on stronger economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between PAYEMS changes and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 signals an imminent recession, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a severe economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to widespread corporate revenue declines and reduced investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 380,000), retail sales growth supports corporate revenue and profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves on robust economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 380000, or the Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor is negative over any 3-year window.
